rationale: Price has rallied sharply from today's low of $125.10 to $131.69, placing it at 99.2% of the day's range and within $0.06 of the session high — the bulk of the intraday move has already occurred. The wide bid-ask spread of 46.3 bps creates an immediate friction cost that is difficult to overcome, and with price pressing against the high on declining 1-minute volume, the risk/reward for chasing a long is poor while a short against a strong recovery momentum lacks a clear catalyst. The setup does not offer a favorable entry in either direction at this moment.
